proposedRule: Integrate a weight-based pediatric dosing calculator into ordering.
needsCoreFeature: Clinically validated calculator, drug-specific formulas and arithmetic correctness.
notes: V1 stores dosingWeight and requires doseCheck to be shown. These names do not prove that a calculator or clinically valid arithmetic exists. Formal UI certification alone is insufficient for the dose calculation.

title: Round pediatric doses with adequate precision
citation: ASTP/ONC 2025 SAFER CPOE Guide RP 2.2, implementation guidance, p. 15
entrenchedBecause: CMS-required annual self-assessment using all eight 2025 SAFER Guides from CY2026 for eligible hospitals/CAHs in Medicare Promoting Interoperability; this practice is assessed, not individually mandated.
proposedRule: Apply dose-rounding precision suitable for low-weight patients.
needsCoreFeature: Drug/formulation-specific precision rules and arithmetic beyond fixed-tenths values.
notes: Source examples illustrate precision; they are not universal decimal requirements. V1 uses tenths for quantities and has no population-aware rounding policy.

title: Offer available pediatric drug concentrations
citation: ASTP/ONC 2025 SAFER CPOE Guide RP 2.2, implementation guidance, p. 15
entrenchedBecause: CMS-required annual self-assessment using all eight 2025 SAFER Guides from CY2026 for eligible hospitals/CAHs in Medicare Promoting Interoperability; this practice is assessed, not individually mandated.
proposedRule: Offer appropriate available pediatric medication concentrations.
needsCoreFeature: Formulation/concentration catalog and pediatric eligibility constraints.
notes: Drug identity alone does not identify liquid concentration or guarantee available strengths. Do not confuse doseUnit with ingredient concentration.

title: Check the maximum daily dose before dispensing
citation: ASTP/ONC 2025 SAFER CPOE Guide RP 2.1, implementation guidance, p. 13
entrenchedBecause: CMS-required annual self-assessment using all eight 2025 SAFER Guides from CY2026 for eligible hospitals/CAHs in Medicare Promoting Interoperability; this practice is assessed, not individually mandated.
proposedRule: Check maximum daily dose before submitting medication orders for dispensing.
needsCoreFeature: Daily-dose aggregation across orders, frequency/PRN interpretation and drug-specific limits.
notes: Dose-range and maximum-daily-dose checks are separate. V1 doseOutOfRange does not establish cumulative daily-dose computation. Alert severity and clinically appropriate overrides require hospital policy; no universal hard ceiling is inferred.
